column1: # The values this mod patches, one per line:
# FILE is the MBIN path the game uses, relative to the data root.
# ENTRY is the MissionID of the table entry to change, matched with
# SPECIAL_KEY_WORDS so the other nine entries are untouched.
# PROP is the field to rewrite (Weighting inside MissionBoardOptions).
# BASE is the value the game ships today.
# VALUE is the value this row writes.
# SCOPES tags the row. A variant renders the rows carrying its tag,
# so one entry has one row per variant that changes it.
# The render step turns the table into the Lua patch list and into
# the expected values that make verify checks the built EXML
# against the shipped weights entry by entry.
# The board rolls one mission per slot weighted by these values.
# Base weights (shipped): H* and SLI* 40, AB* 50, JUNK 20, POSTIE
# 40. A variant writes 1000 for its type and 1 for everything else,
# so the wanted type wins about 99% of rolls per slot.
